instruction: Explain how to switch VLC's slider colors to darker shades through the interface configuration.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's slider colors to blackish tones (qt-slider-colours setting). The evaluator uses existing check_qt_slider_colours metric with type='blackish' which reads the VLC config file and checks if all RGB color values in the slider configuration are below threshold 100 (dark colors). Default colors are bright (153;210;153;20;210;20;255;199;15;245;39;29), so the user must navigate to interface settings and change them to dark colors.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to change VLC slider colors to dark/blackish tones
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts the VLC configuration file containing qt-slider-colours setting
Metric (check_qt_slider_colours) correctly parses the color string and checks if all RGB values are below threshold 100 (blackish)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all colors in the slider configuration, not just some
Expected value structure is correct: type='blackish' maps to the blackish checking logic in the metric
No parameter handling issues: metric receives rule parameter directly as expected for type='rule' getters
